item.title: NASCAR at COTA launches spring festival season in Austin with millions in economic impact
item.description: NASCAR’s return to COTA kicks off spring festival season, bringing thousands of visitors and millions in economic impact to Austin.

item.title: Man gets 27 years following fatal east Austin shooting
item.description: A man was sentenced Feb. 9 in connection with a July 2023 fatal shooting in east Austin.

item.title: Austin home builder leaves behind neighborhood of half-finished homes in Georgetown
item.description: Onx Homes Inc., a modular home manufacturer that had received $120 million in investor capital, has left its 204,000-square-foot lease in Georgetown, and several dozen half-built homes in the area.

item.title: Shane van Gisbergen chases the COTA win that keeps eluding him
item.description: Shane van Gisbergen has dominated NASCAR’s road courses, but COTA remains the one track he hasn’t conquered. With a front‑row start and the best odds in the field, the New Zealander hopes this weekend’s Texas Grand Prix is the breakthrough he’s been chasing.

item.title: Pedestrian killed in South Congress crash, driver left scene: Austin Police
item.description: The Austin Police Department said one pedestrian is dead after an early morning crash on South Congress Avenue Tuesday. This occurred near the intersection of South Congress Avenue and West William Cannon Drive.

item.title: Warm weekend, plenty of sun, rain chances next week
item.description: Warmer than normal temperatures continue through the weekend, with rain chances returning next week. -- Meteorologist Tommy House

item.title: University of Texas study first to review domestic violence hotline chat, text transcripts
item.description: A groundbreaking study published last month examined more than 300 transcripts of chat and text conversations between domestic violence survivors and support hotline operators in Texas, marking what its authors call the "first known" study of its kind.

item.description: Sam Karas wrote on Feb. 18 about those plans.

item.title: How a $150M donation will shape the future of Huston-Tillotson
item.description: After helping Huston‑Tillotson expand its campus in the 1960s, the Moody Foundation has once again entered the school’s orbit—this time with transformative impact.

item.title: Robert F. Kennedy Jr. visits Austin ISD school on nutrition push, draws protest
item.description: He stopped by the school to see what the district is doing to create healthier meals for students, according to HHS.
